_description: Canonical document definitions for Unlocked. Pure data - no Python code.

documents.name: Income Certificate
documents.description: Proof of annual family income issued by Nadakacheri or Atalji Janasnehi Kendra.

documents.name: Caste Certificate
documents.description: Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC) issued via Nadakacheri.

documents.name: Domicile Certificate
documents.description: Proof of permanent residence in Karnataka.

documents.name: Aadhaar Card
documents.description: Unique Identification Authority of India 12-digit biometric ID.

documents.name: Admission Proof
documents.description: Official admission allotment letter or confirmation from a recognized educational institution.

documents.name: Fee Receipt
documents.description: Official fee receipt showing payment made to the educational institution.

documents.name: Previous Marksheet
documents.description: Marks card of previous academic year/semester.

documents.name: Bank Passbook
documents.description: Front page of bank passbook or cancelled cheque displaying account number and IFSC code.

documents.name: Passport Photo
documents.description: Recent passport size photograph.

documents.name: Disability Certificate
documents.description: Unique Disability ID (UDID) or disability certificate from authorized medical authority.

documents.name: Bonafide Certificate
documents.description: Certificate from head of institution verifying regular student status.

documents.name: Ration Card
documents.description: Family ration card issued by Department of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs.

documents.name: Transfer Certificate
documents.description: Transfer certificate from institution previously attended.

documents.name: Land Record (RTC/Pahani)
documents.description: Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops (RTC) obtained from the Bhoomi portal or Taluk office.

documents.name: Aadhaar-linked Bank Account
documents.description: Bank account seeded with Aadhaar and mapped with NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer.

documents.name: Crop Sowing Certificate
documents.description: Official confirmation of crop sown on the survey number, recorded via Karnataka Farmer Crop Survey app.

documents.name: FRUITS Farmer ID Card
documents.description: Farmer Registration & Unified Beneficiary Information System (FRUITS) ID.

documents.name: Soil Health Card
documents.description: Soil health assessment report detailing nutrient status and fertilizer dosage recommendations.

documents.name: Age Proof Certificate
documents.description: Official document establishing age of applicant (Aadhaar, Birth Certificate, School Marksheet).

documents.name: Pension Sanction Order
documents.issuing_authority: Directorate of Social Security and Pensions
documents.description: Official government order sanctioning social security pension.
